exposure: Cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) subtypes (Type I, Type II, Type III)
hysteroscopic surgery alone or in combination with laparoscopic surgery (HCoLC)
uterine artery embolization (UAE) followed by curettage
cohort: The cohort consists of 130 patients diagnosed with Cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) who underwent various surgical treatment approaches.
finding: The study found that the optimal surgical intervention strategy for Cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) is critically dependent on the CSP classification and gestational sac size, with specific treatment recommendations tailored for Type I, Type II, and Type III CSP.
